title: Grepow GRP292434-1C-1S1P-3.7V-210mAh specification approval sheet, Rev A (2021-05-04)
note: Supplied by the user as an upload on November 25, 2026 and stored unchanged; the review environment could not reach DigiKey or Grepow, so byte identity with the copy DigiKey links is unverified. The sheet carries Grepow customer code 63700 and covers the pack with protection board, 90 mm leads and a JST ACHR-03V-S connector. Pack maximum 3.8 x 24.1 x 36.5 mm (the cell body alone 2.9 x 24.0 x 33.5 mm); over-discharge 2.8 V; over-current 3 to 8 A after 7.2 to 11 ms; protection board draws up to 5.5 uA; charge 10 to 45 C at 0.5C standard, 1C maximum, 4.2 V.
